24.original: Patrol the area for suspicious activity.

48.original: You there! Show me your─ah...never mind. You appear strong but do not look vicious enough to commit such an atrocious crime.

49.original: <sigh> You see, the other day we found the dead body of one of our comrades.

50.original: He died of a knife wound to the back and through the chest. Poor bastard. No one turns their back on an enemy, so more likely than not, he was killed by a friend.

51.original: We need to prevent any further casualties, and I ask that you assist us. Please patrol the more secluded areas of our island and save anyone who looks like they might be in danger.

52.original: Please patrol the island for any suspicious activity and save anyone who appears to be in harm's way.

53.original: Hayase requested that you survey the island for suspicious activity? I can't say I have noticed anything out of the ordinary, but I will definitely keep my eyes peeled. Thanks for the warning.

54.original: I have not noticed anything unusual but I will keep my eyes and ears peeled.

55.original: You are looking for a murderer? Ah, well, I am looking for clams. Good for you and sadly for me, I have spotted neither.

56.original: Nope, no murderers...<sigh>...and most definitely no clams around here.

57.original: Nothing suspicious here, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>! Now, if there is nothing else, I really must return to training!

58.original: My apologies, but you are breaking my concentration. If there is nothing else of import, please allow me to carry on with my training.

60.original: Thank the kami you arrived when you did. You saved my life. <sigh> I was tricked into coming here by a man who claimed to be a fisherman. He said he had a job opportunity for me, but I should have known better.

61.original: I must return and have my wounds looked at. You best leave this place, too. There might be others lurking about in the shadows.

62.original: Ah, you have returned. Thank you for surveying the island and saving one of our comrades from certain death.

63.original: We did a bit of investigating and discovered that the alleged fisherman's victims have one thing in common.

64.original: The two of them once stopped a ship full of ronin seeking passage through the Ruby Sea. Upon demanding that they pay the Ruby Tithe, the nomad samurai drew their swords and all hells broke loose. A great deal of blood was shed that day.

65.original: By the sound of it, these men had come to avenge the deaths of their compatriots. It doesn't surprise me. Most ronin are no better than your average criminal.

66.original: Sadly, this incident cost us a good man. Thanks to you, however, we were able to prevent any more casualties. Please accept this gift as a token of our appreciation.
